definitionZh: :-moz-loating CSS伪类是Mozilla扩展,它匹配那些因为尚未开始加载而无法显示的元素,例如尚未开始到达的图像. 注意正在装入过程中的图像不匹配此伪类.
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-loading CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements that can't be displayed because they have not started loading, such as images that haven't started to arrive yet. Note that images that are in the process of loading are not matched by this pseudo-class.
